rubric_items.reason: Built only on modules and symbols that already exist (PatientRepo, PatientService, patientsRouter, PatientsPage, dateTime, the existing index). It follows the route/service/repository layering and needs no migration or new infrastructure.

S-1 to S-5 are each mapped to components, and so is every criterion: latest start, COMPLETED only, '-' for null, one row per patient for paging and search, no sort, Next appointment untouched, no medical history.
EP-1 items[].lastVisitAt gives name, type, nullability, format and an example that matches S-1 AC2. But CO-4 writes the time zone argument as a placeholder instead of naming it.
CO-2 and CO-6 are marked Assumed with 'implement must confirm'. But the null meaning in C13 and EP-1 is credited only to A-11, and that answer does not mention null.
Trade-offs explain why a per-patient subquery beats JOIN plus GROUP BY (no repeated rows when paging), why the API returns the instant and not a formatted string, and why the field is not a sort key.
Clear, consistent CO/EP ids and a story coverage map. One placeholder in CO-4 reduces precision.

findings.text: CO-4 writes the dateTime time zone argument as a placeholder, not as the actual setting (HOSPITAL_TZ, default Asia/Kolkata). S-1 AC2 and AC3 depend on that zone.

cites.quote: dateTime(lastVisitAt, <the time zone Next appointment uses>)

findings.suggested_fix: Name the zone source (HOSPITAL_TZ / Asia/Kolkata), or say it is the same argument the Next appointment cell passes, and leave out the angle-bracket placeholder.

findings.text: C13 and EP-1 say lastVisitAt is null when there is no COMPLETED appointment and credit that to A-11 alone. A-11 only fixes the name and ISO UTC format. The null case comes from REQ-8 / S-2 AC4-AC5.
findings.suggested_fix: Trace the null case to REQ-8 / S-2 AC4 and AC5 next to A-11.
